name: identity_fracture_catalyst
label: The Identity Fracture Catalyst
godotFeature: Custom Resource & Signal System, Particle Systems & Shaders
poeticVision: The player feels the terrible weight of each attack, knowing every trigger pull rips a piece of Lyra's very being away. It's an agonizing choice: gain momentary strength, but irrevocably lose a memory, a skill, a part of who she is. Every 'victory' carved out by this weapon is paid for with self-loss, intensifying the 'grief of self-loss' and the desperate race against internal dissolution.

parameters.name: base_damage
parameters.description: Base damage dealt by the catalyst before fragment modifiers.

parameters.name: particles
parameters.description: Reference to the GPUParticles3D node for activation effects. Assign in the editor.

parameters.name: weapon_material
parameters.description: Reference to the ShaderMaterial applied to the weapon's mesh. Assign in the editor.

verdict: A weapon born of desperation, it carves victories from the very essence of self, turning every triumph into a poignant elegy for what Lyra once was.
impact: This invention transforms combat from a simple damage exchange into a profound, agonizing dilemma. Every attack becomes a conscious sacrifice of Lyra's very self, forcing players to constantly weigh immediate survival against the irreversible erosion of identity. It deepens the 'grief of self-loss' by making it an active, player-driven mechanic, ensuring that every victory feels earned but also deeply costly, intensifying the game's core themes of memory, identity, and desperate survival.
